source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey Larry — this sounds great, I like the approach and timeline.

Let’s move forward.

For the first step, I’d like to focus on:
• system layout
• motor + component selection
• basic wiring plan

Goal is to get a working prototype up and running as quickly as possible, then refine from there.

Let me know what you need from me to get started.

value_updates.deliverable: system layout for the initial working prototype

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Ok. Let's go with this design. It still keeps alive the DJ Turntables vibe. Let's make the pour spot should be facing the baristas. I want the buttons to be functional and work. Let's try and make it as splash free as possible. Keep the words on the machine the same. Green accents. The only difference is I want it to say "Karla's Matcha Mixer". From the side view I like the thickness of the machine. I want deep matcha wells but I don't want the box to be too big.

value_updates.design_direction: adopt the revised design referenced in the preceding exchange

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey — quick clarification on this milestone.

Since the BOM is already finalized and all parts have been purchased and shipped, I just want to confirm that this milestone now covers the finalized system layout and wiring plan (not an additional parts list for purchasing).

Just want to make sure we’re aligned that no additional components are needed at this stage and that we’re moving into the build and integration phase.

Let me know your thoughts.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Hey Karla. Sorry for my delayed response this past week. I have been busy trying to finalize your build. In regards to the food contact materials we are actually looking pretty good. All of the liquid contact areas are made from stainless steel. The enclosure itself is made from PETG plastic which itself is considered food safe even though there is no contact with the enclosure. The silicones used are food grade as well. The machine itself is easily serviceable if parts ever need to be replaced or swapped. The internal plumbing may be trickier than the rest to clean but a simple rinse after use and an occasional bottle brush through the plumbing should be more than enough to keep everything clean. I've got all the documentation saved including the CAD files, materials, Bom and wiring overview.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that the CAD files have been created and saved with the project documentation.

routing_warnings.description: The requested base height and edge-to-edge fit primarily define the independently tracked cup-clearance platform rather than the general CAD deliverable.
The client's removable-spout request is a functional cleaning behavior and should not be absorbed into the general CAD Requirement.
The completed on/off slot is a target-specific implementation claim for the main power interface rather than for completion of the CAD deliverable.
